title: Free Hakuna Matata support package | Your Tanzania Trip
description: Every trip includes our free Hakuna Matata Package: travel file, airport pick-up, private guide, 24/7 support, replacement vehicle and help with disrupted flights.

replace.selector: [class*=ts-jumbotron-content] p
replace.html: Hakuna Matata means no worries. On a trip with us it means something concrete: a support package that is part of every trip, at no extra cost, from the moment you book until you are home.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose > h3:contains("No worries, just wonder")
div.ts-prose > h3:contains("No worries, in practice") + p
replace.html: Flight cancelled on the way out? A puncture an hour from the nearest town? Things like that happen, and the question is who sorts them out. With us, that is settled before you leave. Here is what the Hakuna Matata Package covers.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose > h3:contains("What is the Hakuna Matata Package?") + p
replace.html: The Hakuna Matata Package is the support that comes with every trip we plan. It is not an upgrade and it has no price tag. It covers the preparation before you leave, the people and the vehicle during the trip, and help when something unexpected changes the plan. A few extras, such as travel insurance, a VIP airport service and a local SIM, can be added for a fee.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Before your safari")) h2 + p
replace.html: The trip starts at home, and we want you to know what to expect before you board.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Before your safari")) p:contains("Ahead of your safari")
replace.html: After booking you receive a travel file with your route day by day, the lodges, the activities, the contact numbers in Tanzania and practical notes on visas, money and packing. Your airport pick-up is arranged. You pay a deposit when you confirm and the balance before departure; the amounts and dates are on your proposal. Plans change sometimes, so our cancellation terms are written down plainly in point 5.3 of our terms and conditions.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Flight delay and cancellation support")) h2
div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Help with disrupted flights")) h2 + p
replace.html: This part applies to international flights you book through us.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Help with disrupted flights")) h2 + p + p
replace.html: Delayed, cancelled, missed connection: you call us, and we get to work.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Help with disrupted flights")) h2 + p + p + p
replace.html: If a flight booked through us is cancelled or badly delayed, we look for an alternative, arrange a hotel if you need one and rework the first days of your itinerary so nothing is lost. We deal with the airline on your behalf and pass on any refund. Flights you book yourself are outside this cover; your travel insurance applies then.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("What help can you count on")) h2
div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Support during your trip")) h2 + p
replace.html: Out in the parks, the question is not whether something can go wrong, but who fixes it. That is our team in Arusha.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Support during your trip")) p:contains("On safari you ride")
replace.html: You travel in a maintained 4×4 from Kilimanjaro Nature Tours, with a network of bush garages along the routes and replacement vehicles in Arusha if one is needed. Your private guide stays with you from pick-up to drop-off, and the office in Arusha and we in the Netherlands can be reached 24 hours a day.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Exclusive add-ons")) h2
div.ts-prose:has(h2:contains("Optional extras")) h2 + p
replace.html: A few services fall outside the package and can be added at a cost: a VIP airport service, a local SIM or eSIM, travel insurance, and a farewell experience on your last day. Ask for them when you request your proposal.

replace.selector: td:contains("Flight disruption support when your flight")
replace.text: ✓ Help with disrupted flights, for flights booked through us

replace.selector: td:contains("Vehicle support during your safari")
replace.text: ✓ Replacement vehicle and roadside help on safari

replace.selector: p[class*=mt-8]:contains("Experience Hakuna Matata yourself")
replace.html: Trips that come with the package, like every trip we plan.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(> h2:contains("How our support works")) > p
replace.html: Because our partner has its own office, vehicles and crew in Arusha, help does not have to come from far away. Depending on what has happened we call your guide, the lodge, the airline or the transfer company, and we adjust the rest of the trip with you.

replace.selector: div.ts-prose:has(> h3:contains("Common questions")) > h3
replace.text: Questions about the Hakuna Matata Package

faq.at: div.ts-prose:has(> h3:contains("Questions about the Hakuna Matata Package")) .faq-wrapper

items.q: Is the Hakuna Matata Package included in every trip?
items.a: Yes. It comes with every trip you book with Your Tanzania Trip, at no extra cost: safaris, climbs and beach trips alike. Only the extras (travel insurance, VIP airport service, local SIM, farewell experience) are charged separately.
Nothing. It is part of the price of your trip. We include it because it is how we want every trip to run, not as a selling point.

items.q: What support do I have during the trip?
items.a: A private guide from pick-up to drop-off, the office of Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha, and us in the Netherlands, all reachable 24 hours a day. If the vehicle, a lodge, a transfer or the plan itself needs changing, we arrange it.

items.q: What if the safari vehicle breaks down?
items.a: Vehicles are checked before every trip, but a breakdown can never be ruled out on these roads. Your guide gets help from a garage on the route, or Arusha sends a replacement vehicle, so the safari continues with as little lost time as possible.

items.q: What if my international flight is delayed or cancelled?
items.a: If you booked the flight through us, we look for an alternative, arrange a hotel if needed, adjust the start of your itinerary and deal with the airline, including any refund. For flights booked elsewhere, your travel insurance applies; we still help you adjust the itinerary.
A VIP airport service, a local SIM or eSIM, travel insurance and a farewell experience before you fly home. These are not part of the standard package and are quoted separately.
